messages:
maria: FYI — we started seeing a surge of 5xx from Hosted Inference around 10:22 UTC. Symptoms: 502 from control-plane for auth/session, intermittent 504s from routing-policy, and a handful of client timeouts. Customers impacted: acme-retail, hypercart. Example error body: `\{"error\":\"control-plane: auth-session service returned 502\", \"req_id\":\"req_8a1f3c\"}`

tyler: Can you paste a curl + response headers and a req_id? Also which region?

maria: region=us-west-2. Sample curl + response:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 10:23:04 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: req_8a1f3c
Content-Length: 112

{"error":"control-plane: auth-session returned 502","detail":"upstream error during session validation"}
```

sasha: Looking at traces — requests are failing in the control-plane when routing-policy calls the config DB for policy lookups. DB read latency spiked ~10:20–10:28 UTC causing request timeouts and cascading 502s. Auth/session shows elevated error budget too (connection resets to session-store).

kevin: Datadog metrics confirm a configdb read latency p95 jump from 40ms -> 1100ms in us-west-2. Connection pool exhaustion on the routing-policy side. Could be a bad query or cache miss storm.

maria: Repro steps from support ticket:
1) Hit hosted generate endpoint with token for acme-retail (region us-west-2)
2) Repeat ~200 req/s with sequence lengths ~256 for 2–3 minutes
3) Observe 502s and `upstream read timeout` in response body

riley: Paging oncall now. @riley has been paged (infra-bot).

infra-bot: @riley oncall page: Incident created INC-20240514-328, severity=P2. Playbook: control-plane dependency spike.

riley: Triage notes — routing-policy is making synchronous calls to config-db for per-customer rules. If config-db latency degrades, route timeouts bubble up. Immediate mitigations:
- Increase routing-policy read timeout from 300ms -> 800ms (quick rollback if not effective)
- Enable cached fallback policy for customers with recent successful reads (TTL 30s)
- Add short-term rate-limit on policy lookups per customer to avoid thundering herd

tyler: I'll push a config change to routing-policy timeout + enable cached fallback. Deploying config patch to canary in us-west-2 first.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: configpatch/route-timeout-800ms canary deploy started in us-west-2 (commit=3f9b1a).

kevin: Also investigating config-db: opening read replica to handle spike and checking slow query log. If we see a full table scan we rollback the recent schema change from last deploy.

maria: Support notes -> told impacted customers we're investigating and implemented temporary throttles on new requests. Asked for logs and any specific request ids.

sasha: After canary rolled out, error rate dropped ~70% in canary hosts. Need to monitor for 15m then promote. Long-term: add KV cache for routing-policy lookups and migrate hot rules to in-memory store to avoid sync DB calls.

riley: Assign owners: tyler -> routing-policy config change / promote, kevin -> config-db investigation / replica, sasha -> post-incident RCA and cache design. Support to update customers at :30 and :60.

maria: Copy — support will follow up and collect three example request ids per customer for RCA. Closing loop when RCA posted. :thumbsup:
